News & Events · GPS in Action

People, then numbers.

Every GPS story follows the same arc — knowledge, partnership, implementation, impact — told through the people living it.

1 · Knowledge

Someone knows something

A researcher, a farmer, an archivist — knowledge with nowhere to land.

2 · Partnership

The platform connects

A hub, a lab, a ministry, a company — the right actors find each other.

3 · Implementation

Something gets built

A pilot, a policy, a venture, a curriculum — ideas take working form.

4 · Impact

Lives change, measurably

Documented honestly — including what didn't work.

The first stories

In production

Stories publish as the first programs complete their arcs — beginning with the 2026 Dialogues and the road to Kigali. Each is photography-led, told with its protagonists, in their words.
